# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price tends to revert to the intraday VWAP during shallow pullbacks when the EMA ribbon is bullish, offering a high‑probability long entry. The combination of a VWAP cross‑above from below, a bullish EMA ribbon (8>21>55), RSI below 45 (avoiding overbought conditions), and above‑average volume filters for high‑quality pull‑back bounces in low‑volatility morning sessions.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** On the 5‑minute chart, when the close crosses above VWAP from below, AND 8‑EMA > 21‑EMA > 55‑EMA (bullish ribbon), AND RSI(14) < 45, AND volume > 1.2 × the 20‑bar average volume, go long at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the low of the pullback candle (or 0.5% below entry, whichever is tighter). Target set at 1.5R. After target is hit, trail the remaining position with a chandelier exit (ATR × 3) to allow a runner. Trades are restricted to 09:30‑11:30 ET and only taken when VIX < 18; avoid entries when VIX > 25 or outside the morning window.
